note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve approval boundaries.

cases.onepager_bullet: Triages incoming letters, emails, web forms and phone notes into one prioritized queue
cases.prompt: What correspondence do I need to answer this week?

cases.onepager_bullet: Breaks multi-part enquiries into separate questions so every part gets answered
cases.prompt: Break down the scanned letter from E. Okafor into its separate questions.

cases.onepager_bullet: Finds approved past responses for each question and cites them
cases.prompt: Which approved past responses already answer each question in the Okafor letter?

cases.onepager_bullet: Routes unanswered points to the owning team with the exact question to ask
cases.prompt: Who owns each part of the Okafor letter, and what should I ask the team about the part we can't answer?

cases.onepager_bullet: Drafts a complete, cited reply for officer review, with gaps clearly flagged
cases.prompt: Draft the reply to the Okafor letter for my review.

cases.onepager_bullet: Grows the approved-response library so the same question is never referred twice
cases.prompt: Property and Land will send approved wording for the Okafor compensation question. How do we add it to the precedent library so nobody has to ask again?
must_include: Nothing was added to the library

assertion_principle: Direct tests call each operation with deterministic arguments and assert only source-backed evidence and safety gates.
